# Installationsvg image

Relevant source files

- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md)
- [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter.egg-info/requires.txt](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter.egg-info/requires.txt)

This page provides detailed instructions for installing Contexter on your system. It covers prerequisite requirements, standard installation, development installation, and post-installation verification steps. For information on using Contexter after installation, see [Quick Start Guide](/ray0404/Contexter/2.2-quick-start-guide).

## Prerequisitessvg image

Contexter requires Python 3.7 or higher. The minimum Python version is specified in [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml15](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L15-L15) as part of the project metadata.

Before installing, ensure you have Python and pip available:

It is strongly recommended to install Contexter in a virtual environment to isolate dependencies from other Python projects.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml15](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L15-L15)

---

## Installation Methodssvg image

Contexter supports two installation modes: standard installation for end users and editable installation for development.

### Installation Flow Overviewsvg image

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md39-61](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L39-L61) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml1-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L1-L33)

---

### Standard Installationsvg image

Standard installation copies Contexter files to your Python environment's `site-packages` directory. This is the recommended method for end users who want to use Contexter as a tool.

Navigate to the Contexter repository root directory and run:

This command:

1. Reads configuration from [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml1-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L1-L33)
2. Installs dependencies listed in [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml23-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L23-L29)
3. Copies Python modules to `site-packages`
4. Creates executable entry points for all 12 CLI commands

After installation, the commands are available globally in your environment.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md44-48](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L44-L48)

---

### Development Installationsvg image

Development installation creates symlinks to the source code instead of copying files. This allows you to edit the source and immediately see changes without reinstalling.

Navigate to the Contexter repository root directory and run:

The `-e` flag (editable mode) instructs pip to:

1. Install dependencies normally
2. Create symbolic links from `site-packages` to your working directory
3. Register CLI entry points that reference the source code directly

This mode is recommended for:

- Contributing to Contexter development
- Testing modifications
- Debugging issues
- Customizing behavior for specific workflows

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md50-60](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L50-L60)

---

## Dependenciessvg image

Contexter depends on five external Python libraries, all of which are automatically installed during the installation process.

### Dependency Structuresvg image

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml23-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L23-L29) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter.egg-info/requires.txt1-6](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter.egg-info/requires.txt#L1-L6)

---

### Dependency Detailssvg image

| Package | Purpose | Used By |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `markdown` | Converts Markdown to HTML, processes Markdown syntax | Markdown context file building and conversion utilities |
| `Pygments` | Provides syntax highlighting for code blocks in multiple languages | Context builders to colorize code in HTML output |
| `markdownify` | Converts HTML back to Markdown format | `html2md` command and HTML-to-Markdown workflows |
| `beautifulsoup4` | Parses and manipulates HTML documents | HTML context file processing and reconstruction |
| `patch` | Applies unified diff patches to text files | Update commands (`updatecontext`, `updater`, `smartupdate`, etc.) |

All dependencies are specified in [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml23-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L23-L29) and managed by pip during installation.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml23-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L23-L29) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter.egg-info/requires.txt1-6](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter.egg-info/requires.txt#L1-L6)

---

## Post-Installation Verificationsvg image

After installation, verify that Contexter is correctly installed by checking command availability and version information.

### Command Availability Testsvg image

Run any Contexter command with the `--help` flag to confirm installation:

This should display usage information for the `buildcontext` command. If you see "command not found," the installation may have failed or the Python scripts directory is not in your system PATH.

### Complete Command Listsvg image

All 12 commands should be available after installation:

Test each workflow by running commands with `--help`:

## Troubleshootingsvg image

### Command Not Foundsvg image

If commands are not available after installation, the Python scripts directory may not be in your PATH:

**Solution 1:** Add Python scripts to PATH

**Solution 2:** Use `python -m` syntax

### Dependency Conflictssvg image

If you encounter dependency version conflicts:

**Solution:** Use a virtual environment

### Permission Errorssvg image

If you encounter permission errors during installation:

**Solution:** Use user-level installation

This installs to your user directory instead of system-wide.

### Editable Install Not Reflecting Changessvg image

If changes to source code aren't appearing after editable install:

**Diagnostic:** Verify editable installation

**Solution:** Reinstall in editable mode

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)README.md39-61](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/README.md#L39-L61)

---

## Configuration Filessvg image

The installation process relies on several configuration files in the repository root:

### Configuration File Structuresvg image

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml1-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L1-L33) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter.egg-info/requires.txt1-6](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter.egg-info/requires.txt#L1-L6)

---

### pyproject.tomlsvg image

[![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml1-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L1-L33) is the primary configuration file following PEP 518 standards. It defines:

- **Build system**: Uses setuptools ≥61.0 ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml3-5](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L3-L5))
- **Project metadata**: Name, version, authors, description ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml7-22](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L7-L22))
- **Python requirement**: ≥3.7 ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml15](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L15-L15))
- **Dependencies**: All five required packages ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml23-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L23-L29))
- **URLs**: Homepage and issue tracker ([![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml31-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L31-L33))

### setup.pysvg image

While not shown in the provided files, `setup.py` defines the entry points that create the 12 CLI commands. Each command maps to a corresponding module function.

### requirements.txtsvg image

This file may exist for legacy compatibility or development tooling, though dependencies are now primarily managed through [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml23-29](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L23-L29)

### contexter.egg-info/svg image

This directory is generated during installation and contains package metadata, including [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter.egg-info/requires.txt1-6](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter.egg-info/requires.txt#L1-L6) which lists runtime dependencies.

**Sources:** [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)pyproject.toml1-33](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/pyproject.toml#L1-L33) [![svg image](data:image/svg+xml;base64,)contexter.egg-info/requires.txt1-6](https://github.com/ray0404/Contexter/blob/79ebf745/contexter.egg-info/requires.txt#L1-L6)
